name: Sattu and Roasted Chana Savoury Bowl
steps: Whisk sattu with water gradually until smooth and thick like a savoury porridge.
Season with lemon, cumin, black salt and pepper.
Fold in chickpeas, cucumber and tomato.
Add chopped herbs and stir. Adjust thickness with a little water if needed.
Serve immediately, chilled or at room temperature.
note: A no-cook savoury breakfast inspired by Bihari sattu preparations. Use plain roasted chana flour, not sweetened drink mix.
